title: Mission Intent Runtime Wiring
goal: Wire mission intent into existing acquisition strategy and pivot planning flow so mission type affects lane priority/caps/expected lanes without new scheduler ownership or modules.

acquisition_strategy.py: NonfeedPlanDebug: added mission_runtime_applied, mission_lane_priority, mission_pivot_boost_applied, mission_feed_cap_reason fields
build_acquisition_plan(): set F226A fields in _nonfeed_debug based on _intent
nonfeed_profile_expected_lanes: now uses mission_required_lanes when intent is known (not unknown/org_recon)
build_acquisition_report(): added F226A fields to dict serialization
sprint_scheduler.py: generate_pivot_candidates_from_query() now passes mission_intent from nonfeed_plan_debug
Sets mission_pivot_boost_applied=True when known mission intent is present
pivot_planner.py: No changes needed — generate_pivot_candidates_from_query() signature already accepts mission_intent

new_telemetry_fields.mission_runtime_applied: bool — True when intent is known (not unknown/org_recon)
new_telemetry_fields.mission_pivot_boost_applied: bool — True when known mission intent boosts pivot scoring
new_telemetry_fields.mission_feed_cap_reason: str|None — Always None (FEED capping driven by nonfeed_diagnostic, not mission intent)
